name: Create Draft
description: Create a draft from your Google Workspace email account. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts/create)

configurable_props.name: to
configurable_props.label: To
configurable_props.description: Enter a single recipient's email or multiple emails as items in an array.

configurable_props.name: cc
configurable_props.label: Cc
configurable_props.description: Enter a single recipient's email or multiple emails as items in an array.

configurable_props.name: bcc
configurable_props.label: Bcc
configurable_props.description: Enter a single recipient's email or multiple emails as items in an array.

configurable_props.name: subject
configurable_props.label: Subject
configurable_props.description: Specify a subject for the email.

configurable_props.name: body
configurable_props.label: Email Body
configurable_props.description: Include an email body as either plain text or HTML. If HTML, make sure to set the "Body Type" prop to `html`.

configurable_props.name: bodyType
configurable_props.label: Body Type
configurable_props.description: Choose to send as plain text or HTML. Defaults to `plaintext`.

configurable_props.name: attachmentFilenames
configurable_props.label: Attachment Filenames
configurable_props.description: Array of the names of the files to attach. Must contain the file extension (e.g. `.jpeg`, `.txt`). Use in conjuction with `Attachment URLs or Paths`.

configurable_props.name: attachmentUrlsOrPaths
configurable_props.label: Attachment URLs or Paths
configurable_props.description: Array of the URLs of the download links for the files, or the local paths (e.g. `/tmp/my-file.txt`). Use in conjuction with `Attachment Filenames`.

configurable_props.name: inReplyTo
configurable_props.label: In Reply To
configurable_props.description: Specify the `message-id` this email is replying to.

configurable_props.name: mimeType
configurable_props.label: Mime Type
configurable_props.description: Mime Type of attachments. Setting the mime-type will override using the filename extension to determine attachment's content type.

configurable_props.name: fromEmail
configurable_props.label: From Email
configurable_props.description: Specify the email address that will be displayed in the "From" section of the email.

configurable_props.name: signature
configurable_props.label: Signature
configurable_props.description: An HTML signature composed in the Gmail Web UI that will be included in the message. Only works with the `HTML` body type.
